primary_sources: The Joint Commission Quality Check (qualitycheck.org) — national CSC/TSC/PSC/ASR certifications
DNV Healthcare Accredited Organizations Directory — national CSC/PSC+/PSC/ASR certifications
Idaho Time Sensitive Emergency (TSE) System — state stroke designations (Level I/II/III)
Washington State Department of Health — ECS facility list and designation directory
CMS Hospital General Information — provider identity, address, geocoded via OSM/Nominatim
Hospital press releases and system websites (Providence, Billings Clinic, MultiCare, Banner, etc.)
coverage_note: This dataset tracks hospitals in the regional catchment (WA/AK/ID/MT/WY). It is scoped to regional stroke capability analysis and includes verified national stroke-certified hospitals and selected additional acute-care facilities. It is not a complete census of all acute-care hospitals in the five-state region. Where independent sources conflict on a capability flag, the value from the prior verified edition is retained pending confirmation.

certification_definitions.CSC: Comprehensive Stroke Center — highest level. 24/7 neurosurgery, advanced imaging (CT/CTA/CTP/MRI/DSA), endovascular thrombectomy (EVT), neuro-ICU, stroke research program.
certification_definitions.TSC: Thrombectomy-Capable Stroke Center — 24/7 mechanical thrombectomy for large vessel occlusion, interventional neuroradiology team, neuro-ICU, ≥15 EVTs/year per physician. DNV uses "PSC+" for equivalent.
certification_definitions.PSC: Primary Stroke Center — rapid CT imaging, IV thrombolysis (alteplase/tenecteplase), dedicated stroke unit, 24/7 stroke team, transfer protocols.
certification_definitions.ASR: Acute Stroke Ready — rapid assessment, stabilization, IV thrombolysis, teleneurology 24/7, transfer protocols to higher-level centers. JC calls this "ASRH"; DNV calls it "ASR".
certification_definitions.EVT: Endovascular Thrombectomy — not a certification tier but a clinical capability. All CSCs and TSCs have EVT; some PSCs have EVT without full TSC certification.

certifying_bodies.Joint Commission: Most common U.S. stroke certifier; four-level system (ASRH/PSC/TSC/CSC).
certifying_bodies.DNV: Second-largest stroke certifier; uses ASR/PSC/PSC+/CSC nomenclature. "Integrated Stroke Program Requirements 25-0" effective 2025-08-01 consolidated all DNV tiers.
certifying_bodies.ACHC: Accreditation Commission for Health Care — all four levels.
certifying_bodies.CIHQ: Center for Improvement in Healthcare Quality — ASRH and PSC.
certifying_bodies.Idaho TSE: Idaho state Time-Sensitive Emergency system — Level I/II/III stroke designations; not a national accreditation.
